subject: Essential Mathematics
title: Statistics I

outcomes.text: draw a frequency distribution table for ungrouped data
determine mean, mode and median of ungrouped data,
represent data using bar graphs, line graphs and pie charts,
interpret data from bar graphs, line graphs and pie charts,
appreciate the importance of data organization and interpretation in making effective decisions

inquiry_questions: How do we use statistics in day-to-day life?
coreCompetencies:
Critical thinking and problem solving: the learner develops interpretation and inference skills when collecting data.
Digital literacy: the learner develops the skills of connecting and interacting with digital technology when using digital devices to draw graphs and charts to represent the data collected.
values:
Integrity: the learner displays honesty while working in groups and collecting data such making frequency distribution tables.
Love: the learner is considerate of the other’s when working with peers to extract information from graphs and charts draw conclusions
pcis: Life Skills (Decision Making): the learner makes informed decisions when identifying patterns from the graphs and charts and drawing conclusions.
notes: Suggested favourite-colour example cannot support arithmeticmean/median ofunordered labels;teachcategorycounts/mode and use validnumericcounts formean/median.
